blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: Mary is a professional pole dancer.
exercises.why: «у» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Entities should not be multiplied without necessity.
exercises.why: «без» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мне нужна виза для ___ (въезд) в страну.
exercises.prompt: I need a visa to enter that country.
exercises.why: «для» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Credit relaxation is considered necessary to shore up business.
exercises.ru: Кредитные послабления считаются необходимыми для ___ бизнеса.
exercises.why: «для» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я думаю, ты не досмотрел видео до ___ (конец).
exercises.prompt: I think you didn't watch the video to the end.
exercises.why: «до» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«до» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я вышел из своей ___ (каюта) на палубу.
exercises.prompt: I went on deck from my cabin.
exercises.why: «из» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The prize money enabled me to go on a world cruise.
exercises.ru: Призовые деньги позволили мне отправиться в путешествие вокруг ___.
exercises.why: «вокруг» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: We've been living here since July.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We have just returned from shopping.
exercises.why: «с» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The damage from the typhoon was enormous.
exercises.why: «от» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Trans fats are bad for your health.
exercises.why: «для» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«после» + genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
